title.zh: Polymarket等预测市场面临澳大利亚严监管，ASIC确认尚未收到任何运营申请
title.en: Polymarket等预测市场面临澳大利亚严监管，ASIC确认尚未收到任何运营申请

current_state.zh: Australia's ASIC chair Sarah Court told a parliamentary hearing that no prediction-market operator has applied for a license and that platforms such as Polymarket would face strict review, since their all-or-nothing payoff structure resembles the binary options Australia has already banned.
current_state.en: Australia's ASIC chair Sarah Court told a parliamentary hearing that no prediction-market operator has applied for a license and that platforms such as Polymarket would face strict review, since their all-or-nothing payoff structure resembles the binary options Australia has already banned.
